text: Vowels and elements. Toning is not singing. We hold one vowel and let it vibrate in the body. Each vowel has its own place, its own quality and its own element. The letters are not random.
say: Vowels and elements. Toning is not singing. We hold one vowel and let it vibrate in the body. Each vowel has its own place, its own quality and its own element. The letters are not random. We sing them as they sound in Croatian. Aaah. Ooooh. Eeee. Oh. Never as the names of English letters.

text: A. Grounding. Earth. We focus on the pelvis. The beginning, the ground we stand on. Open sound, open mouth, weight dropping into the feet. Imagine roots growing from your feet, connecting you strongly to the earth, receiving its support and nutrients. You get connected with the earth of every continent.
say: Aaah. Grounding. Earth. We focus on the pelvis. The beginning, the ground we stand on. Open sound, open mouth, weight dropping into the feet. Imagine roots growing from your feet, connecting you strongly to the earth, receiving its support and nutrients. You get connected with the earth of every continent.

text: U. Creativity. Water. We find the two pelvic bones that stick out, left and right a little below the belly button, and focus on the middle point just below the belly. U is the shape of a cup that holds water, and water is what creates. Water makes everything alive: when you put water on the earth, everything starts to grow. From grounding to creativity, creating life and creating everything. The sound gathers and deepens. We vibrate in resonance with lakes, rivers, seas and clouds, everywhere water is.

text: I. Energy. Fire. We focus on the belly button. The sound is projected outwards. With fire we move through life and reach what we set out to reach: we manifest our ambitions, function in this 3D world and get our goals done on time. It is a physical energy, a burning fire. We resonate with the fire of the world: the sun, volcanoes and the glowing core beneath our feet.

text: O. Love and compassion. Air. We focus on the chest, the heart area. A circle. No beginning and no end, we are all one. The sound widens in the chest and out into the room. Our capacity to love expands too, to accept everybody as they are, and our family grows to the whole planet. We breathe with the winds and the sky that wraps the whole earth.

text: A. U. I. O. Truth and communication. Overtone singing. We focus on the throat. The throat is our verbal expression and our vibration. Our voice is like a fingerprint of the whole body, our character and our energy level: everything can be read from our vibration through the voice. We join all four vowels into one unbroken sound, and from the slow passage from vowel to vowel the overtones are born, higher tones above the tone. This is truth and honesty: what we actually have to say, we say truthfully, in the way of non-violent communication. Non-violent communication (Marshall Rosenberg) has four steps: observation, what happened, without judging it; feeling, what I feel about it; need, which need of mine lies under that feeling; request, a clear and doable request, not a demand. It is spoken in two directions: we express our own feelings and needs honestly, and we listen with empathy for the feelings and needs of the other, without blame and without punishment. As with the O, we accept things and people as they are, and we express our truth.

text: AUM. Intuition and wisdom. We focus on the middle of the head, the seat of the third eye and of the pineal gland. The sound of the creation of the universe, as the yogis see it: an eternal, ever-present sound vibrating as the base of creation. Attention climbs behind the eyes and settles, comes to one point, the pineal gland, and then expands, like the big bang, to the whole universe.

text: Silence. Spirit and connection. We focus on the crown of the head, the connection between us and the rest of the universe. At the end we do not sing. We sit in what is left and feel that everything is connected to everything.
